snippet.title: Rabbi Daniel Glatstein Official
snippet.description:
Welcome (or welcome back) to Rabbi Daniel Glatstein's channel, where you'll find insightful and inspiring teachings on Jewish traditions and beliefs. Join our community of subscribers and get updates on the latest videos and events. Don't miss out on the opportunity to learn and grow with us!

Rabbi Daniel Yaakov Glatstein (רב דניאל יעקב גלאטשטיין שליט״א) is an American Orthodox Rav, serving as the Mara D'asra of Kehilas Tiferes Mordechai, Halachik authority and Nasi {President} of Chavra D'Hilchisa, best-selling author of numerous titles in English for Artscroll, and the Maggid Harakiah series in Lashon Hakodesh, prolific researcher, pulpit rabbi and teacher with a global following and one of the most popular English-speaking Torah teachers in the contemporary Jewish landscape. The Rav lives in the Five Towns (Cedarhurst, NY) with his wife and children, where he pursues his research, writing, and teaching for the masses and his Kahal Kadosh. 

Learn more at www.RabbiDG.com

Using AI-assisted visuals grounded in historical research, the channel revives cities as they once existed—before disaster, decline, or transformation erased them. These are not dramatized fantasies,  but carefully rebuilt urban worlds shaped by faith, labor, power, and survival.

Each video is a slow journey through streets, homes, markets, and monuments, presenting history as lived experience rather than spectacle. Architecture, clothing, and daily life are recreated with respect for period detail and human reality.

Reviora is history seen quietly, truthfully, and just before it vanished.

snippet.description:
Welcome to Ancient Editions –
Your portal to the epic story of human evolution, prehistoric life, and the mysteries of our ancient world. We journey back millions of years to reveal how early humans lived, thrived, and adapted in a changing Earth.

Disclaimer!
This channel produces educational and creative reconstructions of historical and prehistoric life. All content is based on academic research, archaeological findings, and informed storytelling to bring history to life in an accessible way.

The visuals, animations, and reconstructions presented are interpretive and intended for educational and entertainment purposes only. They do not represent definitive facts and should not be taken as literal depictions of historical events.

No animals were harmed in the creation of this content. All media used in our productions — including images, music, sound effects, and footage — is either licensed, royalty-free, or used under Fair Use for commentary, research, and educational purposes.

snippet.title: Thomas Relives History
snippet.description:
History has always fascinated me — not only the events that changed the world, but the everyday reality of living through them. The places people moved through without knowing how significant they would become. The ordinary moments unfolding in the shadow of something much larger.

This channel is about reliving the past through visual reconstruction. Using modern tools to step back into earlier worlds — not to reinterpret history, but to experience it from within. From the street level, the workplace, the quiet moments between major events.

Thomas Relives History goes beyond famous landmarks and well-worn timelines. It focuses on environments, processes, and situations that are rarely shown in detail: how places functioned, how moments felt, and how history was lived before it was ever recorded as history.

The goal is simple — to make the past feel closer, more human, and more tangible.

No spectacle. No shortcuts. Just history, relived.

snippet.title: The History Guy: History Deserves to Be Remembered
snippet.description:
History that deserves to be remembered. If you love history, this is the channel for you! Stories of forgotten history, all between five and fifteen minutes long.

Episodes are posted Monday, Wednesday and Friday mornings. 

I have always loved history and believe that history does not have to be boring.

At its heart, history is story telling, and I believe that it should be told with passion and genuine love for the material.  History might be tragic, it might be comic, but it is the story of who we are, and we should not be afraid to enjoy that story, and be moved by it.

I live in the American Midwest, talk too fast but am working on that, and tie my own bow ties.  Yes, the hats in the background are mine.

snippet.title: Fury of the Earth
snippet.description:
Fury of the Earth is a documentary-style channel dedicated to exploring the most powerful forces shaping our planet. Here, we reveal the complete history behind Earth’s greatest geological events — volcanoes, earthquakes, tectonic plate movements, mega-eruptions, climate-changing disasters, and the natural phenomena that transformed human civilization.

Our mission is to turn complex Earth science into clear, visual, and captivating storytelling. Each video brings you full-history explanations, scientific accuracy, and immersive cinematic narratives about iconic events such as Pompeii, Tambora, Krakatoa, Mount St. Helens, Yellowstone, and many more.

This channel is perfect for audiences who love:
🌋 Volcanoes & volcanology
🌎 Geology & tectonic plates
📜 Historical mega-eruptions
🌪️ Extreme natural disasters
🔬 Earth science explained clearly
🎥 Full documentary-style storytelling

Here, we don’t just report the event — we uncover the complete history behind it.

snippet.title: Historical Capital
snippet.description:
Welcome to Historical Capital.
I’m Henry.
This channel examines history as the story of how capitalism was born.
From ancient debt records and early trade networks to medieval banking, mercantilism, the Industrial Revolution, and the rise of global financial markets — we trace the structural evolution of capitalism.
To understand the modern world, we ask:
How did capitalism emerge?
How was capital accumulated?
How did property rights, interest, markets, and financial institutions become dominant systems?
Each episode explores:
Economic history
The relationship between money and power
Financial structures of empires
Through cinematic 4K AI reconstructions and digital archaeology, we transform economic history into visual storytelling.
This is not just history. It is the origin story of modern capitalism.
If you want context beyond headlines, subscribe and follow the path of capital through time.
#Capitalism #EconomicHistory #FinancialHistory #AIHistory #4KDocumentary #HistoricalCapital

snippet.title: HistorYA
snippet.description:
History is not a list of dates and names. It is the story of ordinary people facing extraordinary moments — the cold they endured, the silence they heard, the choices they made when the world changed around them.

HistorYA takes you inside history. Not as a lecture, but as an experience. Through immersive narration and cinematic visuals, we walk the frozen streets of 17th-century London, stand in the ruins of forgotten empires, and witness the quiet resilience of those who came before us.

No sensationalism. No shortcuts. Just history told the way it deserves to be told — slowly, carefully, and with respect for the people who lived it.

New documentaries released regularly. Subscribe, and walk through history with us.
